note: Q-STD arms (docs/fork/QUALITY.md). R = the accepted setup (the launcher + server config as they are); R2 = R again, placement pinned to R's auto budget: must be byte-identical. P1-P3 = prompt-chunk regroupings (the same GPU kernels, prompt cut into other-sized chunks): the rounding controls. D1-D3 / X1-X2 = placement STRESS panel, not rounding controls: CPU experts quantize activations per 256 values (Q8_K), GPU experts per 32 (q8_1), so moving experts between the tiers is a small precision change. Window size is not a control: with placement pinned, --spec 4 gave byte-identical logits (an exactness sentinel). The budgets assume R's auto budget of 1716 on the reference PC: re-derive them from R.<lane>.json facts.auto_budget on another machine.
